title: Fake-DOM piece 0: shared-fake additions (getElementById, attr operators, replaceChild/Children, insertAdjacentHTML, entities, createElementNS, append/prepend) + client-world helpers
description:
Piece 0 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Lands first and alone.** Pieces 2–6 are blocked on it. Piece 1 does not need it and may run in parallel.

**Decision this rests on.** The plan's one team question is whether LIN-4271 may add these APIs to the shared fake. The plan recommends yes and the plan review approved the course change (`db80ceb2`). If the team rules **no** on LIN-4271 or LIN-4255 before this merges, cancel this ticket: pieces 2–6 then become the stop report on their named APIs (the plan's fallback, census 55 → 48).

### Slice of the approved plan

In `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`, each addition with its own case in `tests/unit/fake-dom.test.js`. The case must **fail on a fake that did nothing**; a test that passes on a no-op does not count.

1. `document.getElementById`: the first connected match in tree order, else `null`.
2. `[attr^=v]`, `[attr$=v]`, `[attr*=v]` in the parser's attribute regex and `matchSimple`. `~=` and `|=` still throw, naming the selector.
3. `replaceChild(new, old)`: throws if `old` is not a child, and returns `old`.
4. `insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html)` only. Any other position throws a `FakeDomError`.
5. `·` in the named entities. **Review note 3:** also add `—`, `…` and `×` (`public/common.js:1727`, `:1733`, `:2510`, reached by `observation-ruling-delivery` through `common.js`), each with a case, so piece 3 does not reopen the fake.
6. `replaceChildren(...nodes)` (no arguments empties the element) and `document.createElementNS(ns, name)`. **Review note 1:** pin `tagName` *and* `localName` on an SVG-namespace element (`tagName === 'svg'`, not upper-cased; today `fake-dom.js:206` upper-cases it). Then either keep attribute-name case on namespaced elements (`viewBox`, set at `chart-helpers.js:179-190`; today `:227` lower-cases every name) or state in the header that it is lower-cased. SVG *parsing* in `innerHTML` stays not modelled, and the header says so.
7. `append`/`prepend` (strings become text nodes), `firstElementChild`, `lastElementChild`.

Header: drop each of these from "Deliberately not modelled" where it is listed, and add it to "Modelled". **No other not-modelled line changes:** `style`, `getBoundingClientRect`, event dispatch and `select` stay listed.

In `tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js`, same PR:

* copy `window` and `globals` with property descriptors, not `{ ...stubs }`, or a throwing `localStorage` getter fires at spread time (`lin-4035`: "a storage that throws on read");
* a click helper over `listenersOf('click')` that passes `{ type: 'click', target }` (no bubbling needed; `dispatchEvent` stays inert). Piece 5 also needs it as the replacement for `element.click()` (review note 2);
* document that `withHarnessModels` cannot be applied to `common.js` by `loadWorld`: pass `window.__HARNESS_MODELS__ = harnessModelsBlock()`, or pass `scripts: []` and run the sources;
* the header or JSDoc notes what the live-console suites (piece 6) must pass themselves: a no-op `requestAnimationFrame` (the default calls back synchronously and overflows the stack once interval stubs exist), `setInterval`/`clearInterval`/`cancelAnimationFrame`/`module`, `localStorage` on both `window` and the global (`live-console.js:1519`), and, per **review note 4**, a never-resolving `window.api` (`api: () => new Promise(() => {})`), not `fetch`.

Prove each client-world change in this PR with a direct test (in `fake-dom.test.js` or a small client-world case) that fails without it. Don't wait for the suite that needs it to move.

**No-behaviour-change check.** The plan review confirmed that none of `prompt-section.js`, `question-cards.js`, `brief.js`, `recap.js`, `scan.js` or `decision-panel.js` calls any of the additions. Re-run the four landed `loadWorld` suites and every current `fake-dom.js` consumer, and paste the before/after spec diff (empty).

**Stop record.** `flight-companion-client.test.js` (240 tests) **stays** on the census. Name its stop in this PR's description: `element.style` plus layout read-back. `resizeComposer()` runs at load (`public/flight-companion.js:2033`), writes `style.height` (`:653`, `:663-664`) and reads `offsetHeight`/`clientHeight`/`scrollHeight` (`:662-665`). Do not carve out its 43 non-loading tests.

### Acceptance

* All seven additions are modelled, each with a no-op-fails case. The header's Modelled and not-modelled lists match the code.
* The client-world changes are in and each is tested.
* All existing consumers give an identical spec diff. `fake-dom.test.js` and `fake-dom-census.test.js` are green on the merged head (update the branch against main first: LIN-4267/4268/4269 touch the same header, but the consumer paragraph is a different block).
* The PR names the `flight-companion-client` stop.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

### Outcome (close-out)

Implemented as approved in LIN-4271's plan: PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2303](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2303>), merged as `aeb9d877`. Deviations: none beyond two review-requested test-only fixes (tag-selector case fold, `replaceChild(x, null)`). Full history is in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

comments.body: **Decision recorded: go.** The team answered yes to "may LIN-4271 add the piece 0 APIs to the shared fake?" (2026-11-05T14:42Z, recorded on LIN-4271). The "Decision this rests on" paragraph in this description is now resolved: build this piece as specified. The cancel/fallback branch does not apply. LIN-4281–4285 wait on this ticket's merge.

Beat 1 of 4 (LIN-4279) committed on `feat/lin-4279-fake-dom-shared-additions`: `105bb17c`, local only, no PR yet.

Added to `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`, each with its own case in `tests/unit/fake-dom.test.js`:
- `getElementById`
- `[attr^=]`, `[attr$=]`, `[attr*=]`; `~=` and `|=` still throw, naming the selector
- `·` `—` `…` `×`
- `createElementNS`: SVG `tagName`/`localName` are `svg` (not upper-cased). Attribute case is kept on non-HTML elements (`viewBox`); HTML elements still lower-case.

Before the implementation, 13 new cases failed against the un-implemented fake. Mutation checks confirmed each new behaviour is caught. Consumer spec names: none removed, 17 added (all in `fake-dom.test.js`).

Drift: the ticket says "four landed loadWorld suites"; only three use `loadWorld` (lin-4010, lin-4246, prompt-section-go). lin-4242 imports the fake directly.

Beats 2 and 3 (replaceChild/replaceChildren, insertAdjacentHTML, append/prepend, client-world) are not started.

LIN-4279 implementation is up as a PR for review: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2303 (not merged, not Done).

Head: `5eff545a`. CI run 42051172356: `success`, all seven checks pass (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, ci-success).

What it adds, on `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` and `client-world.js`:
- Fake DOM: `getElementById`, attribute `^=` `$=` `*=`, four named entities, `createElementNS` (SVG names kept as written), `replaceChild`, `replaceChildren`, `append`, `prepend`, `insertAdjacentHTML` (`beforeend` only), `firstElementChild` / `lastElementChild`.
- Client world: `window` and `globals` copied by descriptor (not spread); `clickOn(element)`; `loadWorld` routes to `common.js` documented and pinned.

Verification:
- Every new behaviour has its own case, observed failing against the unimplemented fake, and mutation-checked.
- Full unit suite: `main` 23,608/23,608 pass; branch 23,641/23,641 pass; failing-name diff empty.
- Consumer set (6 files): 217/217 pass; no beat-1 spec name removed.

Stop record: `flight-companion-client.test.js` (240 tests) stays on the census. `element.style` and layout read-back are still not modelled.

Not done here: the merge, and setting this issue to Done.

**Stepper run summary (LIN-4279, autopilot session 3c1f6e93)** — implementation arc complete; PR open for review, not merged, not Done.

Beats run in one warm session (ROOT dispatch 2a6f8cac):
1. `105bb17c` — getElementById, attr `^= $= *=`, 4 entities, createElementNS
2. `e168a35d` — replaceChild, replaceChildren, insertAdjacentHTML (beforeend only), append/prepend
3. `93f72976`, `5eff545a` — firstElementChild/lastElementChild, client-world descriptor copy, `clickOn`, loadWorld route tests + JSDoc, `style` kept in not-modelled header
4. push + PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2303 + CI

Evidence checked by me (not just reported): each beat's commit exists on the branch and the fake-dom/census/consumer tests re-ran green (234/234 after beat 3); PR #2303 is OPEN on head `5eff545a`; CI run 42051172356 passed all 7 checks (Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success) on that exact commit; the only pre-existing test line changed is the `[class^="k"]` unsupported-selector example, disclosed in the PR.

Caught mid-run: my beat-2 prompt omitted `firstElementChild`/`lastElementChild` (ticket item 7); folded into beat 3 after I re-read the ticket.

Left: independent `review`, then `close-out` (merge on green, set Done). The flight-companion-client stop (`element.style` + layout read-back) is recorded in the PR body.

## Review — LIN-4279

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2303, head `5eff545a`. I also tested a local merge of that head with `origin/main` `8369461c` (merge `1830f156`, clean auto-merge of `fake-dom.js`).

CI: green on `5eff545a` (run 42051172356: Unit, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, ci-success). That run is **not** on the merged head: main gained LIN-4268 (#2302), which touches the `fake-dom.js` header and the census. I ran the merged head locally: `npm run test:unit` gave 23,738/23,738 pass, exit 0.

### Scope against plan
- All seven additions are in `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`, and each has cases in `fake-dom.test.js`. The client-world changes are in: descriptor copy of `window` and `globals`, `clickOn`, the routes to `common.js` (JSDoc plus 3 pinning tests), and the live-console prerequisites (JSDoc).
- The diff touches 3 files, all inside the plan's places. Nothing overran.
- Header: the additions moved to Modelled. `style`, `getBoundingClientRect`, event dispatch and `select` are still listed as not modelled. `style` was not listed before, and the PR adds it, as disclosed.
- SVG attribute case is resolved: names are kept as written on non-HTML elements (`viewBox`), lower-cased on HTML elements, and the header documents it. I checked it directly: `svg[viewBox]` matches, `svg[viewbox]` does not, and `outerHTML` gives `<svg viewBox=…>`.
- Three vs four `loadWorld` suites: the drift is disclosed, and all four were run. On the merged head there are 6 `loadWorld` consumers (adding LIN-4268's three).
- The PR body names the flight-companion-client stop (`element.style` plus layout read-back). The suite is still on the census (`fake-dom-census.test.js:63`).
- I checked the cited `live-console.js:1519`: `window.localStorage.getItem` is at 1518–1519.

### Regression check
`git log` on the three files shows no reverts. LIN-4270 (className and id reflect their attributes) is intact: both still go through `getAttribute('class'/'id')`, and on HTML elements `_attrKey` lower-cases the name exactly as before.

### Mutation checks (my own, each reverted)
22 mutations on the merged head. 20 went red: getElementById always null (3); `^=`→includes (1); `$=`→includes (1); each of the 4 entities dropped (1 each); SVG tagName upper-cased (2); namespaced attributes lower-cased (1); `~=`/`|=` accepted (2); replaceChild returns new (1); replaceChildren() no-op (1); insertAdjacentHTML any position (1); append drops strings (1); prepend appends (1); firstElementChild → first node (1); window spread (1); globals spread (1); clickOn without `type` (1); clickOn no-op (2).

**Two survived:**
1. **Type selectors are now case-insensitive only in `matchSimple`.** The PR stopped lower-casing in `parseSimple` and moved the fold to `matchSimple` `case 'tag'` (`isHtmlEl(el) ? el.localName === s.name.toLowerCase() : …`). Removing that fold leaves `fake-dom.test.js` green. So the pre-existing behaviour (`querySelector('DIV')` matches a `<div>`) is now unpinned on a path this PR rewrote. Behaviour is correct today (probed: `DIV`, `P#x` and `[DATA-K]` all match).
2. **`replaceChild` guard.** Removing the `old.parentNode !== this` check stays green. For a non-null non-child this is equivalent, because `_insert` throws `FakeDomError` before anything changes. For `replaceChild(x, null)`, though, `_insert(x, null)` would append `x` and then hit a TypeError, so the tree changes. No test covers `old = null`.

### Isolated or one of a class?
The class is the hand-written fakes on the census, and pieces 1–6 (LIN-4280–4285) own it. Nothing in this piece has an unhandled sibling. The change is isolated.

### Fixes for close-out (test-only, `tests/unit/fake-dom.test.js`)
- **F1:** add a case asserting that an upper-case type selector matches an HTML element: `document.querySelector('DIV')`, `el.closest('P')` and `el.matches('P')` all hit. Add one where an SVG element made by `createElementNS` is **not** matched by `SVG`. Confirm it goes red with the `.toLowerCase()` fold removed from `matchSimple` `case 'tag'`.
- **F2:** add a case where `parent.replaceChild(newEl, null)` throws `FakeDomError` and `parent.childNodes` is unchanged. Confirm it goes red with the `old.parentNode !== this` guard removed.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (acceptance: "fake-dom.test.js and fake-dom-census.test.js green on the merged head"): CI ran on `5eff545a`, before LIN-4268 landed on main. **Before the merge:** update the branch against main and confirm CI is green on the new head. Wrong looks like: the census or the 6 `loadWorld` consumers red. My local run of the merged head was green (23,738/23,738), but that is not an independent clean environment.
- **Inside** (acceptance: "each addition with a no-op-fails case"): the two mutation survivors above. **Before the merge:** F1 and F2, each shown red under its named mutation.
- **Inside** (client-world bullet 4, live-console prerequisites): these are documentation only, as the ticket asks. The `live-console.js:1519` citation is verified. The claim that the default `requestAnimationFrame` overflows the stack once interval stubs exist was not reproduced here. Nothing in this PR depends on it, and LIN-4285 will exercise it when it adopts the stubs. **Settled:** the requirement (documented) is met here and needs no further check from close-out.
- Consumer spec diff: discharged. I re-ran all 9 fake-dom consumers on the merged head (227/227 pass). The PR's beat-1 name diff shows no removals.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The implementation is complete and correct against the plan. Close-out needs to add F1 and F2 and confirm CI is green after updating against main.

## Close-out — LIN-4279

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2303, squash commit `aeb9d877` (pinned with `--match-head-commit 55db1623`). Review verdict was Approve, conditional on the ledger; settled below.

### Changes I made after the approval (nobody else reviewed these)
- `05861839`: merged `origin/main` (`8369461c`, LIN-4268) into the branch. Clean auto-merge. Answers review's "update the branch against main".
- `55db1623`, test-only, `tests/unit/fake-dom.test.js`:
  - **F1** (survivor 1): new cases that an upper-case type selector matches an HTML element (`querySelector('DIV')`, `closest('P')`, `matches('P')`, `matches('P#x')`), and that an SVG element from `createElementNS` is *not* matched by `SVG`. Mutation check: removing the `.toLowerCase()` fold in `matchSimple` `case 'tag'` turns the first case red; folding for non-HTML elements too turns the SVG case (and the existing SVG-name pin) red.
  - **F2** (survivor 2): new case that `replaceChild(newEl, null)` throws `FakeDomError` and leaves `childNodes` unchanged and `newEl` unattached. Mutation check: replacing the `!old || old.parentNode !== this` guard with `false` turns it red. `fake-dom.js` was restored and shows no diff.
- No source or assertion change; no stale citations from this change.

### CI
GitHub Actions exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). On the exact head `55db1623`, run 42054158923: Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success all SUCCESS, read fresh before the merge. Locally on that head: `npm run test:unit` 23,741/23,741 pass. After the merge, `main` at `aeb9d877`: `fake-dom.test.js` + `fake-dom-census.test.js` 130/130 pass (the acceptance's "green on the merged head").

### Ledger
- **Inside — fake-dom and census green on merged head:** done; CI on the post-main-merge head plus the runs above.
- **Inside — no-op-fails cases (two survivors):** done; F1 and F2, each shown red under its named mutation.
- **Inside — live-console prerequisites (docs only):** review settled it (requirement documented; `live-console.js:1519` citation verified). The claim that the default `requestAnimationFrame` overflows the stack once interval stubs exist was not reproduced; nothing here depends on it, and LIN-4285 will exercise it when it adopts the stubs.
- **Consumer spec diff:** discharged by review (227/227).
- **Outside items:** none in review's ledger, so no follow-ups filed and no existing-ticket check needed.
- **Named monitor / rollback:** none named by review.

### After the merge
Test helpers and tests only; there is no deploy and no post-deploy step. Verified on merged `main` as above.

### Housekeeping
- Description archived (`GET /brief?noRefresh=1`, snapshot confirmed via `/snapshots`, captured 2026-11-05T15:19:10Z). The description holds only scope and acceptance (the plan lives on LIN-4271), so nothing was pruned; a short outcome stub was appended.
- LIN-4281–4285 were blocked by this ticket and can now proceed; LIN-4271 stays In Progress. The `flight-companion-client` stop (`element.style` + layout read-back) is named in the PR body.
